name: Nilkamal Limited
summary: Nilkamal Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells plastic products in India and internationally. The company offers bins and crates, pallets, material handling equipment, shelving and racking systems, insulated boxes, waste management solutions, road safety barriers for infrastructure management, and hospitality sector products for commercial food preparation and service, as well as provides related technical services.
